title: Add review signing readiness contract
summary: Autonomous workflow status calls out project review signing key custody, public key publication, rotation, and release evidence policy as the next hardening step. Add a read-only readiness report and validator so signed review artifacts stay blocked until a human-approved project key policy exists.
expectedFailureModes: Signed review artifacts are treated as release-grade evidence without project key custody or public key publication.
Docs mention review signing readiness but no validator enforces the blocked state or required human decisions.
Readiness output includes local key material, local paths, or personal identities.
nextAction: Add review-signing-readiness report/validator, document the custody gate, wire the validator into script validation, and keep signed review artifacts blocked without a project key.
